office: # How the events of each central office (data/central-offices.csv, one row per key) are read every day by scripts/office-events.mjs into data/central-office-events.json. short = the badge label. events_page = the office's own events page (linked from its card). import = yes or no: no stops reading that office's events (they disappear from the site at the next import). crawl_delay = seconds between two requests to that website (its robots.txt can ask for more; at least 2).

# adapter: tribe = The Events Calendar's REST API (feed = …/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events); aanoc = NOCCO's events page (cards, plus its RSS feed in options rss=); tvco = Temecula's hand-typed events page (feed = the page in the WordPress API); watch = no events are read: the page in feed is only looked at once a day and the report says when it changed (import does not matter); shared = the office shares another office's website and calendar (options from=); none = nothing to read.

# options, separated by ; — drop_categories=a,b (leave out events in these categories) · drop_only=a (leave out events whose only category is a) · description=off (the office's description text is not used) · flyers=description (the flyers are the pictures inside the description) · merge_days=yes (the same title on following days is one event) · title_cleanup=yes (cut dates and times typed into titles; ALL CAPS becomes Title Case) · title_case=yes (ALL CAPS titles only) · watch=<address> (also watch that page) · rss=<address> · from=<office> cities=a,b title=<pattern> (shared). checked = the day the row was last checked; notes are for editors · card=pictures or card=list (an office whose events are not read: its card on /calendar/central-offices/ says it posts them as pictures or as text, and links its events page).

notes: robots.txt asks for 20 seconds between requests. The monthly Intergroup Meeting (category Intergroup only) and the New Meeting announcements are not events.
